function laterParameter({value=later}={}, later=1) { return value; }
function laterObjectSibling({first=second,second=1}={}) { return first; }
function laterTupleSibling([first=second,second=1]=[]) { return first; }
function typedObjectSibling({first=second,second=1}:{first?:number;second?:number}={}) { return first; }
function typedTupleSibling([first=second,second=1]:[number?,number?]=[]) { return first; }
function nestedSibling({nested:{first=second,second=1}={}}={}) { return first; }
function selfObject({value=value}={}) { return value; }
function immediateArrow(value=(()=>later)(),later=1) { return value; }
function immediateFunction(value=(function(){return later;})(),later=1) { return value; }
function wrongDefault({value="wrong"}:{value?:number}={}) { return value; }
function optionalOverload(value?:string):void;
function optionalOverload(value:string){}
function nullableOverload(value:string|null):void;
function nullableOverload(value:string){}
